faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do booking and payments work?
faq.a1: Select your desired tour and click the WhatsApp button. Our team will coordinate dates, schedules, and meeting points. Payment is completely safe with zero hidden upfront fees.
faq.q2: Are community and favela tours safe?
faq.a2: Yes! All our community experiences (Rocinha, Vidigal, Baile Funk) are led exclusively by respected local resident guides.
faq.q3: Can I customize a package with multiple tours?
faq.a3: Absolutely! It is very common to combine the Rocinha Tour in the morning with the Two Brothers Hike in the afternoon or the Classic City Tour. Just message us on WhatsApp.
faq.a4: We provide assistance and tours in Portuguese, English, Spanish, and German.
